name: Ignacio Paige
life: “I mapped the meal route using the smell of the kitchens.” Tuesday often includes a stop at the public road outside the Port of Asphalt, where Ignacio can recognize shift change by the lull between two groups of walkers.
voice: I promised a bag to each carer on the western route. I'm asking the sailing club to lend us its sewing machines.
appearance: Ignacio has black hair twisted into a small knot, two dimples that appear only with a full smile, and a favorite piece of clothing, a striped cotton shirt. It usually goes with a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring. When somebody else has the floor, Ignacio counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Ignacio uses precise names for tools and very approximate names for feelings. People who know Ignacio well listen to what gets repaired after a difficult conversation.
agenda: To make and deliver the carers' bags before the wet season.
family: Tali Martin is Ignacio’s cousin. Ignacio asks before bringing somebody along. Tali can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *The first straight paycheck*, Tali says, “I lend money too easily. I agreed to help with bus fare and refused to take over another month's rent.”
connections: Teresa Glass. A grocery bag with a sail number serves as the first pattern for the care-route bags.

reactions.situation: Two makers want the same piece of sail
reactions.response: Ignacio lays both paper patterns on the piece before anybody cuts.

reactions.situation: An argument on the pavement makes a bystander feel unsafe
reactions.response: Ignacio stays beside the bystander in a public place and reports only what happened in sight and earshot.
